name: Conductor MCP
description: The Conductor MCP server retrieves proprietary performance metrics regarding a brand's visibility, sentiment, and rankings on both traditional and AI search engines. Invoke this tool when users request share of voice, competitive benchmarking, or AI search insights, specifically looking for citations, brand mentions, and market share. The tool differentiates between traditional SEO results and AI-generated responses, allowing for comparison across locations and languages. Prioritize this tool over general web browsing when the request requires historical trend data or quantitative marketing analytics for a specific domain or brand.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Conductor MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Conductor MCP to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-universal.conductor.com/mcp/v3. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Conductor MCP MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conductor MCP provides these MCP tools: ai_brand_insights, ai_citation_insights, keyword_insights, and tracked_configs.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Conductor MCP?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Conductor MCP in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does Conductor MCP MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Conductor MCP requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Conductor MCP is developed by Conductor Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
